products.name: Sprout S1
products.description: Wi-Fi soil moisture and light sensor for house plants, with a desktop companion app and a cloud service that sends watering alerts.
products.sold_in: All EU countries (online), plus two plant shops in Belgium
products.sales_channels: Own web shop, a Crowd Supply campaign, two plant shops
products.expected_use: 5 to 7 years. The battery can be replaced; the soil probe wears out after about 6 years.
products.update_method: over-the-air (OTA) updates for the sensor, sent from Sprout Cloud; the companion app updates through its own installer
products.automatic_updates: Security updates install automatically at night by default. You can postpone an update for up to 7 days, or switch automatic updates off in the companion app (Settings > Updates).
products.how_to_check_version: Settings > About in the companion app shows the sensor firmware version and the app version.
products.after_support: The sensor keeps working on your local network but gets no more security updates. We will tell you 12 months before support ends and explain how to keep using the sensor safely or recycle it.
support_reasons: Customers keep plant sensors for 5 to 7 years; the probe wears out after about 6 years.
Six years from launch (March 2025 to March 2031) covers the expected use time and is longer than the five-year minimum.
The ESP32-C3 chip family and our cloud hosting contract are both expected to stay available for longer than that.

component_support.note: Plan the move to a newer ESP-IDF release line in 2027.
Move Sprout Cloud to a newer Python version before October 2027.
Move to the next long-term support version of Node.js in early 2027.
